title: EasyChat
description: EasyChat Is A Plugin That Formats Player Chats, Has AI Moderation, And Many more features
body:
![Easy: Chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5657dd6da57bb3ffcf7ef0a4907cd983b9792491.png)

Easy Chat Is a plugin that Format's Minecraft's Chats, It changes how player chats look, adds Moderation Tools, and way more exciting features! More features will come soon so stay tuned!
(This plugin is on its testing phase, if you encounter any bugs PLEASE report it)
#
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc2a9f805a298ccc087ea7315b799e0b3caf0d92.png)

- Advanced Chat Formatting System
  - Minimessage support (colors and gradients EVERYWHERE)
  - Different Chat Formats For Different Groups 
  - PlaceholderAPI Support
  - Hover And Click Effects With Player Messages
  - Mention System, Able to mention players and get pinged
  - Custom Chat Styles (Players can pick what theme they want on)
  - Emoji Systems, Create custom emojis and provide permissions to them
- AI Moderation System (WORKING API KEY REQUIRED)
  - With Word Blocking based on config
  - With Word Censoring based on config
  - Staff getting pinged
- Punishment System
  - Banning
  - Warning
  - Notes
  - Kicking
  - And Temporary Versions!
- Player Tags
  - Permission Locked Tags
  - Player Customization To Tags
- Word Filtering
  - Filter Words that will be censored
  - Bypass Permissions
- Markdown Support For messages
  - bold text
  - italic text
  - underline text
  - strikethrough text
  - Permission controlled
- Command Blocking System
  - use to remove the commands entirely (so you dont see the /<command> in chat
- Join/Leave 
  - Custom Join/leave message + can be changed per group
- Welcome message, Players can receive welcome message depending on their group
# MORE UPCOMING FEATURES SOON
![Support](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3406723a274d2f22e7e3131cd5295d5d92e9f78.png)
